$comment: REAL DATA, transcribed by hand from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFHP (AIP France, AMDT 10/24, chart dated 2024-09-05).
Only facts are recorded here; the charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed.
Runway geometry, taxiways, parking and frequencies also come from the simulator at run time; this file holds
what the simulator does not know: services, circuit rules and reporting points.
Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Le Puy-Loudes

service.atsHours: MON-FRI 0530-0900, 1000-1300, 1530-1900 (UTC in winter, local time minus 1 h in summer); not provided SAT, SUN and public holidays
service.outsideAtsHours: air-air frequency only (French only); opening possible on PPR 48 h

notes: Landing runway 15 prohibited when there is no ATS or when the PAPI is out of service.
Simultaneous take-off and landing on the unpaved and the paved runway are prohibited.
The unpaved runway is unusable after heavy rain. Taxiing prohibited except on runway and taxiway.
Glider winching (NR 997) up to 5000 ft AMSL on the grass strip, announced on Le Puy Info or air-air; cable not beaconed.
Parachuting on the aerodrome (NR 437) up to FL160; parascending SR-SS up to 1300 ft AAL.
